note: The three VPcmFloModem visual diagnostics against t_v34diag.  A SECOND suite over this source, beside `vpcmflomodem` and `vpcmep3`: suites.json maps one name to one source and one binary, and t_vpcmflomodem does not call these three at all, so a mutation in them would read NOT CAUGHT against it -- which is the same output an untested claim gives.  Twenty-nine other sources in this file are already shared that way.

the equaliser scale is a double
why: 10000 is exactly representable as both a `float` and a `double`, and under `-mfpmath=387` the product is computed at 80 bits either way, so `coefs[i] * 10000.0f` and `coefs[i] * 10000.0` are the same value for every input.  The object's `flds` is what says the literal was a float; nothing observable turns on it, which is why `getConstellation`'s `fldl` -- where the two constants are NOT the same value -- is the one that separates.
